I fixed issue #920 in my local git worktree (branch `bench`) by simplifying the `BASE_WHISPER_PROMPT` in `node-bot/whisper-prompt.js`. The fix was straightforward: reduce the prompt to just "Mana" since the `WakeWordMatcher` already accepts those variants on its own. I updated the comment to explain the change and ran all 14 existing tests, which all passed.
